newsitem.title: ITALY: INSTANT VIEW - Bank of Italy 75 bps rate cut.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Bank of Italy 75 bps rate cut.

text.p: Following are economists' reactions to the 75 basis points cut in the Bank of Italy's key discount rate to 6.75 percent from 7.50 percent on Tuesday.

Mario Noera, head of research at Deutsche Bank in Milan, told Reuters Financial Television: "A cut was not expected today, but good data on inflation had indicated a cut soon, by the end of this week anyway.
"The cut was not a surprise to the markets -- the real surprise was the slightly better than expected CPI data which has triggered an overdue Bank of Italy rate cut," he said.

Italian January consumer prices were seen at 0.2 percent month on month and 2.6 percent year-on-year, according to analysts' estimates based on preliminary data from 11 sample cities on Monday and Tuesday.
